sources.name: Laurentian International (International Student Services)
sources.notes: P-210 Parker Building, 935 Ramsey Lake Rd. Best-fit source for the city (orientation, cultural nights like the cited Bengali Night at Fraser Auditorium) but events are only posted to their Facebook page (facebook.com/LaurentianInternational), no calendar/feed found on the main site - confirmed 2026-08-26. Registered probe; revisit if Laurentian International starts using a real events page.

sources.name: Cambrian College - International Student Support Services
sources.notes: Runs International Student Orientation, SIN clinics, and an active International Student Association (Diwali/Holi/Vaisakhi events on the Barrydowne campus). Main site (cambriancollege.ca) is a Next.js app with no wp-json/tribe route - confirmed 2026-08-26. No calendar feed found; college also runs an /events/ section for individual event pages (e.g. International Virtual Open Day) but no bulk feed. Re-probe cambriancollege.ca/orientation directly.

sources.name: Greater Sudbury Public Library
sources.notes: Runs Mugo (a Drupal-based library CMS, 'Powered by Mugo Library' footer credit) - NOT Communico, unlike Hamilton/Kingston's libraries. No JSON/RSS/ical route found in page source on a first pass 2026-08-26. 13 branches, main branch Mackenzie (downtown). A Mugo parser added centrally would unlock this source.

sources.name: Laurentian University Orientation (hand-entered)
sources.notes: Fall orientation week hand-entered since laurentian.ca 403s to bot fetches (see laurentian-international probe above) - found via search snippet only, not the primary source page.

sources.name: YMCA of Northeastern Ontario - Immigrant Services
sources.notes: 10+ years running newcomer settlement in Greater Sudbury - multilingual staff, personalized settlement plans, referrals. Contact newcomer-info@ymcaneo.ca. No dated-events feed found - hand-enter workshops/info sessions as announced.

sources.name: Sudbury Multicultural and Folk Arts Association (SMFAA)
sources.notes: City-run (Tom Davies Square, 200 Brady St) settlement/community-orientation program for immigrants and refugees - housing, school registration, government forms, stress-adjustment workshops. Contact smfaa@greatersudbury.ca / 705-674-4455 ext 1242. No feed found - hand-enter.

sources.name: LINC Sudbury (Language Instruction for Newcomers to Canada)
sources.notes: Federally funded (IRCC) free English classes for adult newcomers/permanent residents at 85 Larch St - listed on a church-directory site but is a government-funded settlement program, not a ministry, so filed practical not spiritual. Standing Tue/Thu evening classes (6:30-8:30pm), no specific dated sessions published. Registered manual with an empty list; contact 705-675-8405.

sources.name: City of Greater Sudbury Events Calendar
sources.notes: Runs on a ColdFusion-based city site (JSESSIONID/CFID/CFTOKEN cookies) - not a recognized platform, no feed found. City festivals sourced via web search and hand-entered in manual_events instead.

sources.name: Discover Sudbury Tourism Calendar
sources.notes: Time.ly (time.ly) hosted SaaS calendar, slug 6m22g7ko / numeric id 21269328. Unblocked 2026-09-10 with the new `timely` parser: the JSON events API is auth-walled (403 to anything but the widget's own first-render XHR), but `api/calendars/<id>/export?format=ics` is public and returns a wide-window (~16-month) iCalendar feed - the parser walks it like a plain .ics and filters to the build window. 85 in window. Big tourism calendar (concerts, markets, festivals) - social stream, relies on scoring for newcomer/student relevance.

sources.name: Greater Sudbury Festivals (hand-entered)
sources.notes: Sourced via web search since neither the City calendar nor Discover Sudbury's Time.ly widget are scraped yet - Sudbury Ribfest and Cinefest Sudbury hand-entered with confirmed 2026 dates. Northern Lights Festival Boreal (Jul 10-12 2026) already passed this build's 3-month window.

sources.name: Free Believers in Christ Fellowship International - Sudbury
sources.notes: The clearest explicitly-international-named congregation found in Sudbury ('International Fellowship' in the name). Only reachable via Facebook - no standalone website, so service times/address could not be confirmed (Facebook page content did not render for scraping). Registered manual with an empty list; needs a human to check the Facebook page directly for service times before drafting anything.
